# Praevius — Complete Product Information

> Construction programme software you can talk to. Import your MS Project, Asta Powerproject or Primavera programme, update it by voice or keyboard in the browser, and export it for MS Project or Primavera. One price per company. Talk to your programme.

Website: https://praevius.app
Contact: info@praevius.app | sales@praevius.app
Support: support@praevius.app
Get started free: https://app.praevius.app/login
Free Trial: https://app.praevius.app/start-trial?bundle=professional

---

## What is Praevius?

Praevius (from Latin "praevius", meaning "going before") is browser-based construction scheduling software. It runs the construction programme — Gantt chart, critical path, float, baselines and progress — with a programme AI assistant that you can speak to or type to.

The workflow is: import the programme you already have (MS Project, Asta Powerproject or Primavera), update it by voice or keyboard, check it, and export it for MS Project or Primavera. One plan per company, with no per-user fees.

Cost control is a separate module on the same platform and projects (Essential plan and above).

Praevius was built by quantity surveyors with 20 years in construction across the UK, Australia and Poland. It is the programme and cost platform of the BIM Takeoff (https://bimtakeoff.com) ecosystem.

## Who is Praevius For?

- Subcontractors who must produce and update their own package programme
- Package planners who receive programmes in different formats from different main contractors
- Site managers who need to update progress and dates without a desktop planning licence
- Small and mid-size main contractors running subcontractor and package programmes
- Quantity surveying practices that also use the cost control module

Praevius is built for subcontractor, package and mid-size main-contractor programmes, not 10,000-activity megaprojects. Primary markets: UK and Australia.

## Programme

### Scheduling
- Critical path scheduling on the programme calendar; critical tasks marked; total and free float
- FS, SS, FF and SF links with lags
- 8 constraint types: as soon as possible, as late as possible, start/finish no earlier than, start/finish no later than, must start on, must finish on
- Deadlines, milestones, hammock tasks and WBS structure
- Project calendar and holidays
- Several programmes per project, with one marked current

### Editing
- Gantt chart: drag to move, stretch and link tasks
- Keyboard grid like MS Project, for example `3, 5SS+2d` for predecessors, `2w` for two weeks, `2ed` for two elapsed days
- Bulk edit; undo and redo
- Several users with full history and conflict protection

### Baselines and progress
- Baselines, and comparison with a baseline or a saved version
- Progress with status date, percent complete and actual dates

### Validate
- Quality warnings: open ends, negative float, constraints that fight the logic

### Limits
- No resource or cost loading in the programme
- Up to 2,000 tasks per programme (150 on the Free plan)

## Import and export

### Import
- Formats: MS Project .mpp, MS Project .xml, Asta Powerproject .pp, Primavera .xer
- Up to 20 MB, 2,000 tasks and 3,000 links per file
- Each import arrives as a new draft and never overwrites an existing programme
- Before you confirm, an import report shows task and link counts, how many dates move and what could not be carried

### What is kept
WBS, FS/SS/FF/SF links with lags, 8 constraint types, deadlines, milestones, notes, project calendar and holidays, progress (percent complete, actual dates, status date), hammock tasks, activity codes and custom fields.

### What is not kept (listed in the import report)
Task calendars, split tasks, percentage lags, resources and costs, P6 secondary constraints, links to tasks outside the file, links on summary tasks (moved or dropped) and baselines stored in the file.

### Export
- Export for MS Project (MS Project XML) or Primavera (XER), plus PDF (A3) and Excel
- Each export shows a report of what could not be carried (for example, in MS Project XML hammock tasks and activity codes as text; in XER elapsed durations and lags)
- No native .mpp or .pp export. Asta Powerproject can import the MS Project XML (it may convert calendars).

## Voice

### How it works
1. Click the mic in the assistant panel (available on every page).
2. Speak. The live transcript appears and you can edit it.
3. After about 2 seconds of silence it sends, with a visible countdown.
4. The assistant replies on screen and makes the change.

- Handles self-corrections, for example "ten days, no, twelve"
- Queues speech while the assistant is busy
- Confirm by voice with "yes" or "go ahead"; cancel with "no" or "cancel"
- Replies are on screen, not spoken
- Typing always works as an alternative

### Browsers and languages
- Uses the browser's speech recognition: Chrome, Edge and Safari. Not Firefox.
- Needs an internet connection.
- Languages: English and Polish.

### Examples
- "Create a programme starting next Monday: groundworks 3 weeks, then frame 8 weeks, then fit-out 6 weeks."
- "Push frame out a week."
- "Groundworks can't start before 3 March."
- "What's driving the finish?"
- "Shut the site for Christmas."
- "Baseline this as the contract programme."
- "Piling started on 3 March and is 60% done."

Site phrasing such as "a fortnight" and "must be done by…" is understood.

## Programme AI assistant

- 18 programme tools: create, batch edit (up to 200 changes), links, calendars and holidays, baselines, compare with a baseline or saved version, restore, undo and redo, validate, custom fields and activity codes, export XML/XER, import
- Builds a programme from a spoken or typed description; asks for missing durations; lists every assumption ("Assumed: …")
- Explains the critical path and driving predecessors; lists tasks by float

### Confirmation model
- Ordinary edits apply at once and can be undone (last 25 steps).
- Larger or destructive changes are proposed first and run only when you confirm: deleting more than 10 tasks, imports, restores, deleting a programme or a field, and changing the current programme.

## Agent access (MCP)

Agent access is available over MCP with OAuth sign-in; read on every plan, write actions need Professional or Scale and your confirmation.

Server URL: https://app.praevius.app/api/mcp. Works with agents that support remote MCP servers, such as Claude, Cursor or Codex; sign in with Google or Microsoft; remove an agent at any time under Settings → Security → Connected agents.

## Pricing

One plan per organisation. The plan is the only thing sold: no per-user fees and no per-module prices. All prices in USD, per month. Annual billing available at a lower price.

30-day free trial on Essential and Professional, no credit card required. Scale starts through sales. A trial that ends without payment falls back to the Free limits; nothing is deleted.

Every plan includes email support at support@praevius.app.

### Free — $0/month
Get started with projects and programmes.
- Up to 3 projects
- 1 team member
- Programme module: 1 programme of up to 150 tasks
- Programme assistant (150 requests/month)
- Agent Access: read access over MCP
- Call to action: Get Started

### Essential — $99/month
For solo QS and small subcontractors.
- Up to 10 projects
- Up to 3 team members
- Programme module: 10 programmes of up to 2,000 tasks
- Programme assistant (3,000 requests/month)
- Cost Control
- Google Drive Sync, SharePoint Document Sync
- 1 of the 3 accounting modules: Xero Invoicing, QuickBooks Online or Sage Intacct
- Agent Access: read access over MCP
- Call to action: Start Free Trial

### Professional — $229/month (Most Popular)
For growing firms with multiple projects.
- Up to 25 projects
- Up to 10 team members
- Programme module: unlimited programmes of up to 2,000 tasks
- Everything in Essential
- All 3 accounting modules: Xero Invoicing, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct
- AI Assistant and Agent Access (full AI assistant; agent read and write)
- Call to action: Start Free Trial

### Scale — $449/month
For mid-market contractors and multi-office teams.
- Unlimited projects
- Unlimited team members
- Programme module: unlimited programmes, baselines and schedule imports
- Everything in Professional
- Procore ↔ SharePoint Sync
- Schedule of Values
- Call to action: Contact Sales (https://praevius.app/contact.html)

## Cost control (secondary module)

Cost Control is a separate module on the Essential plan and above. It runs on the same platform and projects as the programme.

- Budget vs actual tracking with traffic-light variance indicators: green within ±5%, yellow at 5–10%, red above 10%
- S-curve forecasting with Cost Performance Index (CPI) and Estimate at Completion (EAC)
- Change order (variation) register with status tracking and approval workflow
- Progress claims with percentage complete, retention tracking and claim history (UK JCT/NEC, AU SOPA, US AIA formats)
- AI variance reports from plain-English requests, part of the AI Assistant module (Professional and Scale)
- Schedule of Values: Scale plan only
- Integrations: Xero Invoicing, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, Google Drive Sync, SharePoint Document Sync; Procore ↔ SharePoint Sync on Scale

## Praevius compared with MS Project, Asta Powerproject and Primavera P6

| | Praevius | Desktop planning tools (MS Project, Asta Powerproject, Primavera P6) |
|---|---|---|
| Where it runs | Browser, nothing to install | Installed application or enterprise server |
| Pricing model | One plan per company, no per-user fees | Licensed per user |
| Formats | Imports .mpp, .pp, .xml, .xer; exports for MS Project (XML) or Primavera (XER), with import and export reports | Native file formats |
| Updating | Voice or typing through the AI assistant, plus Gantt and keyboard grid | Keyboard and mouse |
| Scope | Critical path, float, baselines, progress; no resource or cost loading; up to 2,000 tasks per programme | Full resource and cost loading; very large programmes |

For resource-loaded or very large programmes, keep your desktop planning tool. Praevius suits subcontractor, package and mid-size main-contractor programmes.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Praevius?
Praevius is construction programme software you can talk to. Import your MS Project, Asta Powerproject or Primavera programme, update it by voice or keyboard in the browser, and export it for MS Project or Primavera. One plan per company, no per-user fees.

### Which scheduling files can Praevius import?
MS Project .mpp and .xml, Asta Powerproject .pp and Primavera .xer, up to 20 MB, 2,000 tasks and 3,000 links. Each import arrives as a new draft and shows a report of task and link counts, how many dates move and what could not be carried before you confirm.

### Can I export my programme back to MS Project, Asta or Primavera?
You can export for MS Project (MS Project XML) or Primavera (XER), and to PDF (A3) and Excel. Each export shows a report of what could not be carried. There is no native .mpp or .pp export; Asta Powerproject can import the MS Project XML, and it may convert calendars.

### How does voice work, and which browsers and languages are supported?
Click the mic in the assistant panel, speak, and edit the live transcript if needed. It sends after about 2 seconds of silence. Replies are on screen. Voice uses the browser's speech recognition in Chrome, Edge and Safari (not Firefox) and needs an internet connection. Languages: English and Polish. Typing always works.

### Does the AI change my programme without asking?
Ordinary edits apply at once and can be undone (last 25 steps). Larger or destructive changes — deleting more than 10 tasks, imports, restores, deleting a programme or a field, and changing the current programme — are proposed first and run only when you confirm.

### Does Praevius do resource or cost loading?
No. The programme has no resource or cost loading. Cost Control is a separate module on Essential and above.

### How large can a programme be?
Up to 2,000 tasks per programme (150 on the Free plan).

### Is there a free plan?
Yes. The Free plan includes up to 3 projects, 1 team member, 1 programme of up to 150 tasks, 150 programme assistant requests per month and agent read access over MCP. Cost Control starts on the Essential plan.

### Are there any per-user fees?
No. The organisation buys one plan, and the plan sets the number of team members (1, 3, 10 or unlimited on Scale). There are no per-user or per-module fees.

### What about annual billing?
Annual billing available at a lower price.

### What happens when the free trial ends?
Essential and Professional start with a 30-day free trial with no credit card. Scale starts through sales. A trial that ends without payment falls back to the Free limits. Nothing you created is deleted.

### What's included in support?
Every plan includes email support at support@praevius.app.

### Can I change plans later?
Yes. Change your plan anytime from the Billing page. If you cancel, your plan stays active until the end of the billing period, and you can reactivate it before that date.

### Can I connect my own AI agent?
Agent access is available over MCP with OAuth sign-in; read on every plan, write actions need Professional or Scale and your confirmation. Server URL: https://app.praevius.app/api/mcp. Works with agents that support remote MCP servers, such as Claude, Cursor or Codex; sign in with Google or Microsoft; remove an agent at any time under Settings → Security → Connected agents.

### Does Praevius still do cost control?
Yes. Cost Control is a separate module on Essential and above, on the same platform and projects: budget vs actual tracking, variance indicators, change orders and progress claims. Schedule of Values is on the Scale plan only.
